honors: 國立臺灣藝術大學設計學院多媒體動畫藝術學系 114 學年度畢業創作影片補助
honors_en: NTUA Department of Multimedia & Animation Arts Graduation Project Grant
desc: 基於皮亞傑認知發展理論設計之 VR 哲學冒險解謎遊戲。體驗者化身虛擬生命體 12T06 經歷感覺動作、前運思、具體運思至形式運思等關卡試煉，並依遊玩累積失敗次數導向雙結局分支。核心聚焦於模組解耦、關卡流程抽象化與 XRI 3.0 的工程實踐。
desc_en: VR puzzle adventure game based on Piaget's cognitive development theory. Players embody artificial lifeform 12T06 traversing sensorimotor, preoperational, concrete, and formal operational stages leading to dual branching endings. Focused on modular decoupling, level abstraction, and XRI 3.0 engineering practices.
contributions: XR Interaction Toolkit (XRI 3.0) 整合與輸入遮罩：配置 6DoF 雙手近遠端射線與抓取組件，實作事件驅動輸入遮罩與裝飾器防呆回彈機制，解決 VR 抓取穿模卡死問題。
關卡生命週期與模板方法模式 (Template Method)：建立 BaseLevelManager 抽象基類固化開場、語音時序、解謎判定與通關切換骨幹，各關卡控制器專注特化邏輯。
過場時序調度與中介者模式 (Mediator)：設計 StageSequenceController 協調全景暗角淡出 (ScreenDimmer)、語音 (AudioManager) 與 3D 空間字幕 (SubtitleController)。
模組解耦與泛型事件匯流排 (EventBus)：實作純 C# 靜態泛型 EventBus 搭配領域事件結構體，消滅場景內昂貴的 FindObjectOfType 與物件間的強耦合。
ScriptableObject 音訊配置資產化：運用 SFXList 集中管理 6 大關卡語音引導、環境音與機關音效對應陣列，實現外部化資料驅動設計。
contributions_en: XRI 3.0 Integration & Locomotion Masking: Configured 6DoF near-far rays and direct interactors, implementing event-driven locomotion masking and decorator pattern anchors to prevent VR drop-through clipping.
Level Lifecycle & Template Method Pattern: Designed BaseLevelManager abstract base class solidifying cutscenes, audio cues, and stage transitions while isolating stage-specific puzzle checks.
Cutscene Sequencing & Mediator Pattern: Authored StageSequenceController coordinating screen dimming, audio narration, and 3D spatial subtitles via coroutine pipelines.
Decoupled Generic EventBus: Implemented pure C# static generic EventBus with domain event structs, eliminating expensive FindObjectOfType calls and tight scene coupling.
ScriptableObject Audio Architecture: Externalized voice lines, environmental ambiance, and interactive mechanical SFX via SFXList ScriptableObject container.

honors: 2022 全國大專及高中職學生專題製作競賽成果展示 - 第一名
2022 Unreal Engine 5 臺灣遊戲創意設計大賽 - 佳作
2023 放視大賞遊戲組 - 初選入圍
honors_en: 1st Place in National Special Topic Contest
UE5 Taiwan Game Contest - Merit Award
desc: 基於 Unreal Engine 5 開發之 3D 多人合作第一人稱射擊遊戲。玩家需於限時內協同對抗敵群並採集星球能源，考驗戰術反應與射擊操作。榮獲 2022 全國大專專題製作競賽第一名及 2022 UE5 臺灣遊戲創意設計大賽佳作。
desc_en: 3D co-op FPS game built with Unreal Engine 5. Players engage in tactical combat against enemy hordes and gather planet energy under tight time constraints. Winner of 1st Place in the National Special Topic Contest and Merit Award in the UE5 Taiwan Game Contest.
contributions: 核心系統全藍圖開發：獨立建構玩家控制器、核心 UI 狀態流與關卡狀態機切換機制。
AI 行為與感知系統：運用 Behavior Tree 與 AIPerception，實作怪物巡邏、感知追擊、動態包圍與戰術移動邏輯。
地形與 3D 資產整合：負責 Landscape 巨型地形編輯、3D 武器模型製作、LOD 效能優化與引擎導入。
contributions_en: Core Blueprints Dev: Independently built Player Controller, UI state flow, and level state machine switching logic.
AI Behavior & Perception: Integrated Behavior Tree & AIPerception for enemy patrolling, tactical flanking, and siege logic.
Terrain & 3D Assets: Landscape giant terrain editing, 3D weapon modeling, LOD optimization, and engine asset pipeline.

desc: 由 Unity 開發之灰階極簡風 2D 音樂動作跑酷遊戲。玩家隨節奏奔馳於隨機生成的平台跑道，並透過音訊快速傅立葉轉換 (FFT) 頻譜分析即時驅動畫面視覺、鏡頭追焦、UI 律動與多層視差滾動背景。核心聚焦純 C# 有限狀態機 (FSM)、Cinemachine 鏡頭震波脈衝與高頻物件池管理。
desc_en: 2D rhythm action runner developed in Unity with a minimalist grayscale aesthetic. Features real-time FFT audio spectrum analysis driving dynamic visuals, camera focus, UI pulsation, and multi-layer parallax backgrounds. Centered on pure C# Finite State Machine (FSM), Cinemachine beat pulses, and high-frequency object pooling.
contributions: 純 C# 玩家有限狀態機 (FSM)：實作獨立狀態機模式管理 Running, Jumping, Sliding, WallClimbing 與 Hurt/Dead 等狀態，徹底解耦複雜物理運動與動畫邊界。
即時頻譜解析 (FFT) 與 Cinemachine 鏡頭震波：呼叫 AudioSource.GetSpectrumData 解析即時頻率，重低音拍點瞬間動態觸發 Cinemachine 2D 正交攝影機脈衝震波與音波幾何跳動。
高頻跑道與音符物件池 (Object Pool)：針對隨機地圖模組、懸浮音符與障礙物實作泛型物件池，杜絕運行時 Instantiate/Destroy 造成的記憶體碎片與垃圾回收卡頓 (GC Spike)。
本地 JSON 存檔管線：採用 ISaveService 策略契約搭配原生 JSON 序列化，結合髒標記機制實現最高連擊 (Combo) 與通關紀錄安全落盤。
contributions_en: Pure C# Player Finite State Machine (FSM): Architected standalone FSM managing Running, Jumping, Sliding, Wall Climbing, and Hurt states with decoupled physics transitions.

Real-Time FFT Spectrum & Cinemachine Beat Pulse: Analyzed real-time audio frequencies via AudioSource.GetSpectrumData, dynamically triggering Cinemachine orthographic impulses and reactive waveforms on bass beats.
High-Frequency Object Pooling: Built generic pooling for procedural platform chunks, notes, and obstacles, completely eliminating runtime GC spikes and memory fragmentation.
Local JSON Persistence Pipeline: Designed ISaveService strategy pattern with native JSON serialization and dirty flags for persistent high score and combo tracking.

desc: 基於行動擴增實境 (Mobile AR) 之新竹神社歷史文化導覽遊戲。使用者透過手機鏡頭掃描實體景點或圖卡，觸發對應之神社建築 3D 模型與歷史解說，並藉由問答測驗加深文化認知，達成古蹟虛實整合體驗。核心聚焦 Vuforia 辨識、雙指縮放手勢、ScriptableObject 題庫與本地 JSON 存檔管線。
desc_en: Mobile AR historical and cultural exploration game for Hsinchu Shrine. Users scan physical signs or cards using their mobile camera to trigger 3D shrine architecture and historical narratives, accompanied by interactive quizzes for cultural edutainment. Centered on Vuforia tracking, pinch-to-zoom gestures, ScriptableObject datasets, and local JSON persistence.
contributions: Vuforia 圖卡掃描與 3D 建築錨定：整合 Vuforia Engine 實作實體解說牌與圖卡特徵辨識，即時生動浮現縮小比例之神社 3D 模型與古蹟結構細節。
雙指觸控手勢照片縮放 (Pinch-to-Zoom)：針對歷史老照片檢視，實作行動端平滑雙指拉伸、平移與視窗邊界鉗制演算法，提升細節瀏覽流暢度。
ScriptableObject 資料驅動題庫：以 ScriptableObject 建構模組化文化問答資料結構，解耦歷史考據文字、選項與判定條件，大幅降低題型維護成本。
UI Animator 參數雜湊快取與本地存檔：快取 Animator.StringToHash 杜絕行內字串查找開銷；透過 ISaveService 策略契約將探索進度與成就記錄保存至本地 JSON。
contributions_en: Vuforia Tracking & 3D Architectural Anchoring: Leveraged Vuforia Engine for image tracking, overlaying scaled 3D shrine models and cultural structures seamlessly in augmented reality.
Mobile Pinch-to-Zoom Gesture Algorithm: Implemented responsive dual-finger pinch zoom, panning, and boundary clamping for high-res archival photo inspection.
ScriptableObject Data-Driven Quiz Architecture: Modularized cultural Q&A datasets with ScriptableObject containers, completely decoupling historical text and scoring logic.
UI Parameter Hash Caching & JSON Persistence: Cached Animator.StringToHash identifiers to eliminate string lookups; persisted quest progress via ISaveService architecture.

desc: 專為孩童與家庭設計之 VR 體感投籃與分類教育遊戲。將籃球投擲的體感樂趣與生活垃圾分類常識結合，分為體感投籃分類與環保知識小學堂兩大階段。核心聚焦 Meta Quest SDK 抓取拋擲物理結合、高頻拋擲物件池管理、雙階段關卡時序流轉與本地 JSON 存檔管線。
desc_en: VR basketball and environmental sorting edutainment game designed for children and families. Combines physical throwing mechanics with waste sorting awareness across two gameplay phases. Centered on Meta Quest SDK throwing physics, high-frequency object pooling, dual-phase stage sequencing, and local JSON persistence.
contributions: Meta Quest SDK 物理抓取與職責分離：利用 6DoF 空間姿態計算出手線性與角速度向量模擬自然拋物線手感，將硬體 SDK 限制在物理層，領域層 TrashItem 專注回收規則與得分仲裁。
零 GC 垃圾物件池 (Object Pooling Pattern)：自研泛型 ObjectPool 與 IPoolable 生命週期契約，杜絕高頻生成垃圾引發之記憶體碎片與垃圾回收停頓 (GC Spike)。
ScriptableObject 題庫與雙階段流程流轉：運用 ScriptableObject 配置環保常識題庫；LevelManager 統一調度 Phase 1 投籃與 Phase 2 知識問答時序與倒數計時。
本地 JSON 存檔管線與最高紀錄快取：實作 ISaveService 策略契約搭配原生 JSON 序列化，結合髒標記機制實現最高分紀錄非同步安全落盤。
contributions_en: Meta Quest SDK Physics & Separation of Concerns: Captured 6DoF controller velocity for realistic throwing trajectories while strictly isolating SDK physics from domain classification rules.
Zero-GC Object Pooling Pattern: Built generic ObjectPool with IPoolable lifecycle contracts, preventing GC spikes and frame drops during intense repetitive throwing sessions.
ScriptableObject Datasets & Dual-Phase Sequencing: Configured educational Q&A datasets via ScriptableObject; coordinated basketball throwing and quiz stages via LevelManager.
Local JSON Persistence Pipeline: Designed ISaveService strategy pattern with native JSON serialization and dirty flags for persistent high-score tracking.

title_zh: 飛機檢修行動學習平臺
honors: 2021 第四屆臺灣數位媒體設計獎 - 大專組互動科技應用 - 銀賞
honors_en: 2021 4th Taiwan Digital Media Design Award - Interactive Tech Silver Medal
desc: 針對空中巴士 A330 客機檢修訓練開發之跨平臺行動學習軟體，以煞車器拆解與安裝模擬為核心教案。
desc_en: Cross-platform interactive learning app for Airbus A330 brake assembly maintenance training.
contributions: UI/UX 視覺系統獨立設計：獨立負責全套專業檢修介面視覺設計與美術素材製作（版面、按鈕、狀態指示圖標）。
UGUI 流程與狀態機建置：將自製素材導入 Unity 規劃 UGUI 邏輯，編寫複雜檢修步驟的核心互動機制與流程切換。
contributions_en: UI/UX Visual Design: Independently designed full aviation maintenance interface, layout, buttons, and status icons.
UGUI Logic & State Machine: Integrated custom assets into Unity UGUI to program complex interactive maintenance procedures.

honors: 2023 通訊大賽聯網未來挑戰賽 - 決賽入圍
desc: 基於情境教學與語言學習開發之 VTuber 虛擬角色互動直播與簡報系統 (VAILSS)。學習者透過扮演虛擬角色進行情境模擬，提升語言表達能力。
desc_en: VTuber virtual character presentation system (VAILSS) for contextual language learning. Responsible for core 3D character assets, environment topology, and visual tuning.
contributions: 3D 角色與場景資產建置：獨立負責核心虛擬角色與 3D 故事場景建置、拓撲減面與引擎內資產效能調校。
動態導覽與展演影像製作：負責全案動態導覽流程編排、視聽效果調校與展演影片剪輯製作。
contributions_en: 3D Character & Environment Assets: Built core virtual characters and 3D scenes, topology polygon reduction, and engine performance tuning.
Motion Navigation & Video Production: Directed dynamic tour navigation, audio-visual tuning, and showcase video editing.

desc: 專業級全端動態線上問卷調研與多維數據分析平臺。支援 7 大型態動態題目編排、條件跳題動態解鎖、預覽審查全卷結構檢視與來源標記、原生 DOM 雙向防誤判、即時統計圖表聚合、4 大專業格式匯出 (CSV / SPSS / JSON / PDF) 與 GUEST/MEMBER/ADMIN 三層身分授權治理。雙軌雲端部署於 Cloudflare Pages (前端) 與 Render (後端 Docker 容器)。
desc_en: Enterprise-grade fullstack dynamic survey and multi-dimensional analytics platform. Features 7 dynamic question types, conditional branch unlocking, preview mode with structural audit, real-time statistical aggregation, multi-format export (CSV / SPSS / JSON / PDF), and 3-tier RBAC authorization. Deployed on Cloudflare Pages (Frontend) and Render Docker Web Service (Backend).
contributions: 全端架構與三層防線：前端採用 Angular 19 獨立元件架構與響應式表單 (Reactive Forms)；後端基於 Java 21 / Spring Boot 實作 Controller-Service-Repository 分層架構與無狀態 JWT 雙權杖安全防禦。
資料持久化與高可用雲端資料庫：採用 TiDB Cloud (MySQL 8.0 協定) 搭配 38/38 全 PASS 之單元與整合測試套件，落實嚴格交易防護與 3NF 模型設計。
動態題目編排與條件跳題解鎖：支援單選、多選、文字、數字、評分量表與矩陣題型，實作前端條件跳題判斷引擎與作答驗證。
多格式數據匯出與即時圖表分析：結合統計聚合演算法，提供問卷填答即時視覺化圖表，並支援 CSV、SPSS、JSON 與 PDF 專業報告匯出。
雙軌雲端自動化部署與保活機制：前端託管於 Cloudflare Pages 全球邊緣 CDN；後端以 Docker 多階段建置發布至 Render，並配置 Actuator 健康探針由外部 24/7 監控保活。
contributions_en: Fullstack Architecture & 3-Tier Layering: Angular 19 standalone components and reactive forms paired with Java 21 / Spring Boot Controller-Service-Repository architecture and stateless JWT dual-token security.
Database Modeling & Cloud Infrastructure: Connected to TiDB Cloud (MySQL 8.0 protocol) with 38/38 PASS unit and integration test suite, ensuring safe transactions and strict 3NF schema.
Dynamic Question Engine & Conditional Branching: Implemented 7 question types with reactive validation, conditional jump rules, and preview auditing.
Data Analytics & Multi-Format Export: Developed real-time statistical aggregation dashboards supporting CSV, SPSS, JSON, and PDF report generation.
Dual Cloud Deployment & Health Probing: Automated edge deployment on Cloudflare Pages and multi-stage Docker containerization on Render with Actuator 24/7 health probing.

desc: 基於 Angular 19 與中央氣象署 (CWA) 開放資料 API 所打造之臺灣即時與未來天氣預報網頁應用。透過 D3.js 向量地圖、Canvas 幾何粒子與氛圍感天氣轉場，提供全臺 22 縣市即時氣候觀測指標與一週未來預報，重點展示前端細緻排版、資料視覺化與 API 串接整合能力。
desc_en: Taiwan real-time and forecast weather web application built with Angular 19 and Central Weather Administration (CWA) Open Data API. Features interactive D3.js vector maps, Canvas particle effects, and dynamic weather ambience transitions, providing full meteorological indicators across all 22 counties alongside weekly folding forecasts.
contributions: 互動式臺灣向量地圖：採用 D3.js v7 搭配 TopoJSON Client，實現主島縣市向量地圖的流暢渲染、懸停聚焦、縮放與選取縣市即時連動。
中央氣象署 API 即時串接：串接中央氣象署開放資料平臺 API，支援全臺 22 縣市及鄉鎮市區之即時平均氣溫、體感溫度、高低溫、降雨機率、相對濕度、風速風向及紫外線指數等完整氣象指標。
一週未來預報折疊面板：設計多時段未來預報展開與收合組件，清晰呈現早晚與日期預報，兼顧行動端與桌面端響應式排版。
動態氛圍感視覺與 Canvas 粒子：實作 HTML5 Canvas 動態幾何粒子系統，並根據晴天、多雲、雨天等氣候狀態切換環境背景平滑淡入轉場。
contributions_en: Interactive Taiwan Vector Map: Leveraged D3.js v7 and TopoJSON Client for responsive county map rendering, hover focus, and synchronous state linkage.
CWA Open Data API Integration: Integrated Central Weather Administration APIs for real-time temperature, apparent temperature, precipitation probability, humidity, and UV index across 22 counties.
Weekly Forecast Folding Accordion: Developed multi-period weekly weather accordion components with seamless responsive layouts.
Canvas Particle Ambience & Dynamic States: Built HTML5 Canvas particle system with smooth background transitions responsive to current meteorological conditions.

desc: 以 React 19 與 TypeScript 建構之個人作品集與視覺化 CMS 管理後臺。前端採用 Tailwind CSS 實作賽博風格與高對比深淺色介面；資料層架構本地快照搭配 Firebase Firestore 雙向即時監聽；後端整合 Firebase Auth 權限控管與 Cloudflare Workers 邊緣部署。
desc_en: A personal portfolio and visual CMS dashboard built with React 19 and TypeScript. Features a cyberpunk high-contrast theme via Tailwind CSS, local snapshot with real-time Firebase Firestore synchronization, Firebase Auth access control, and Cloudflare Workers edge deployment.
contributions: CMS 視覺化管理後臺：為首頁、簡介、技能、專案與經歷等展示模組打造專用管理介面，實作未儲存防跳出機制（Unsaved Guard）與多語系即時同步。
資料快取與即時同步：結合本地靜態 JSON 與 Firestore onSnapshot 串流監聽，達到首屏即時呈現與後臺儲存無須重整即時反映之混合資料流。
身分驗證與安全控管：串接 Firebase Authentication 實作管理員登入流程與 Token 生命週期管理，保護後臺資料操作邊界。
多媒體與雲端資產管理：串接 Firebase Storage 支援圖片資產上傳，並實作 SVG 技術圖示與動態靜態資源映射。
互動視覺與無障礙設計：實作 Canvas 粒子互動背景、發光游標與進場動畫，並嚴格遵循深淺色對比度規範。
CI/CD 自動化建構與部署：配置 GitHub Actions 工作流於推送時自動執行型別驗證與打包，並自動發布至 Cloudflare Workers。
contributions_en: Visual CMS Admin Dashboard: Developed dedicated management interfaces for Hero, About, Skills, Projects, and Experience modules, with unsaved changes warnings and multi-language synchronization.
Data Caching & Real-Time Sync: Combined local static JSON with Firestore onSnapshot listeners to achieve immediate first-paint and instant cloud sync without page refreshes.
Authentication & Security: Integrated Firebase Authentication for administrator sign-in and token session lifecycle management.
Cloud Media Asset Management: Leveraged Firebase Storage for image uploads alongside dynamic SVG icon and static asset mapping.
Interactive Visuals & Accessibility: Built Canvas particle background, custom cursor, and smooth scroll animations adhering to high-contrast accessibility guidelines.
CI/CD & Edge Deployment: Configured GitHub Actions to run type checks and automated builds on push, deploying automatically to Cloudflare Workers.
